intent: Record as reviewed the size, version, reuse, storage and path rules the packaging Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context packaging lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A package the packager has built is refused when its zip exceeds the produced-size ceiling, and the refusal is counted.
Planning a package refuses a version that belongs to another Skill, so one Skill's gates are never applied to another Skill's files.
Packaging the same content again reuses an existing package only while it is available, not deleted, not purged and not expired; otherwise a new one is built.
Before any package object is stored, a Workspace that may not store objects is answered not found and nothing is written.
A file whose path holds a backslash or starts with a drive letter is left out of a package as an unsafe path.
